audit.whatIsWrong: Row 4 (Level 6) reads Vayne in both layers while whys[4] and spikes[1] both say Perfect Execution's two casts let Akali all-in you, and the packet chart reads Akali. Row 6 (2+ items) reads Akali in both layers while whys[6], late and spikes[3] all say Blade of the Ruined King plus Final Hour outscales her, and the packet chart reads Vayne.
audit.why: 50.51% over 1776 games with a chart that should read Vayne / Skill / Akali / Akali / Akali / Akali / Vayne. Two rows contradicted their own prose.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side and win[4] = Akali at 4/10; phases[6].side and win[6] = Vayne at 7/10. Rows 0-3 and 5 already agree with the packet chart and are left alone.
sources: brief currentText content whys[4], whys[6], late

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] labelled Shuriken Flip as "R1" and Perfect Execution as "R2". Shuriken Flip is Akali's E; Perfect Execution is the R with two casts. The level-6 spike text also never states that the R recast is an execute.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon: E = Shuriken Flip (16/14.5/13/11.5/10s), R = Perfect Execution (120/90/60s), recast executes enemies struck. The slot mislabel makes the cooldown advice unusable.
audit.corrected: Shuriken Flip (E) plus Perfect Execution (R); R recast executes low targets, so track the HP number. Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four places state that Akali's Five Point Strike heals her (whys[1], spikes[0], mid, wants.foe[0]). Riot's description for Q is damage plus a slow — no healing component. Also missing: the execute threshold on Perfect Execution's recast, and the Assassin's Mark auto-reset being the wind-up tell for her burst.
audit.why: A phantom heal makes players avoid trades they actually win. Her limiter is energy (110/100/90/80/70 per Q), not lifesteal — after two Qs she is out and cannot follow up.
audit.corrected: Q slows and costs 110 energy at rank 1 with no heal; after two Qs she is dry. R recast executes — stay above the threshold. Step back on the Assassin's Mark wind-up, not the cast.

audit.why: packet suspectNames flags wants.you[1] "Bait Twilight Shroud" — FALSE POSITIVE. Twilight Shroud is the correct Riot name for Akali's W; the matcher is scoring the leading verb. No edit made. The akali-side mirror's finding that Perfect Execution grants no untargetability is respected here — no text on this side claims it.

edits.before: Final Hour stealth-tumbles break every engage pattern onto you. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Akali's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Perfect Execution's two casts gap-close and then execute, so Final Hour's stealth-tumbles do not save you below the threshold at 6.

edits.before: At 2 her Q slow-and-heal out-trades itemless Vayne.
edits.after: At 2 her Q slows and chunks itemless Vayne first.

edits.after: Once Akali has Q (Five Point Strike) plus her passive she out-trades you: Q slows and costs 110 energy at rank 1, and she can proc her ring twice to burst you before Silver Bolts even stacks. Respect her energy — after two Qs she's out and you can walk up.

edits.after: From 2 through her ult she takes over: Q slows for 110 energy, her shroud drops your aggro and cancels Silver Bolts, and at 6 Perfect Execution's two casts all-in you. Farm at range, don't chase into smoke.

notes: Biggest fix here is the phantom heal on Five Point Strike, repeated in four fields — Riot's Q text is damage plus slow only, and her real limiter is energy. Also corrected spikes[1] calling Shuriken Flip 'R1'. Chart rows 4 and 6 flipped in matched full/content pairs to match the packet chart and the surrounding prose. Several full-layer strings on this matchup still refer to Akali as 'he' (tradeGood, tradeBad, dontsFull[2].d, breakdown.feeding) — left alone this pass because they are boilerplate shared across the champion's matchups; worth a champion-level sweep.
